newsitem.title: USA: ITT closes Madison Square Garden sale.
newsitem.headline: ITT closes Madison Square Garden sale.

text.p: ITT Corp said Tuesday it completed a $650 million sale of its half stake in Madison Square Garden to Cablevision Systems Corp.

The company said it received $500 million in cash from Cablevision for a 39.8 percent interest in Madison Square Garden, which is home to the New York Rangers hockey team and the New York Knicks basketball team.
The sale reduced its stake in the Garden to 10.2 percent from 50 percent. ITT said it is guaranteed to receive at least $150 million more for its remaining stake in one of two ways.

The company said it has the option to require Cablevision to buy half of its remaining interest in Madison Square Garden exactly a year from today for $75 million and the remainder two years from today for an additional $75 million.
If it does not exercise the option, Cablevision can require ITT to sell its stake for the greater of $150 million or fair market value exactly three years from today.
After all the transactions are concluded, Cablevision will fully own Madison Square Garden. ITT said it also sold an aircraft used by the Knicks and Rangers to Cablevision for $38 million.
